title: Harlem Heat becomes WCW’s defining tag team
summary: Booker T and Stevie Ray rise from challengers to repeat champions. Their long partnership gives WCW a durable team identity across the pre-Nitro and nWo eras.

chapters.title: The first championship airs
chapters.result: Harlem Heat defeats Stars and Stripes for the tag titles.
chapters.context: This is the broadcast date of the match recorded on December 8, 1994. The brothers begin their championship rise.

chapters.title: The Outsiders take the championships
chapters.result: Hall and Nash defeat Harlem Heat for the tag titles.
chapters.context: The nWo expands its championship control at the expense of WCW’s established team.

chapters.title: A tenth championship
chapters.result: Harlem Heat wins the vacant tag titles in a street fight.
chapters.context: The reunited brothers reach their tenth reign, a final championship peak for their original partnership.
